noticias.titular: Peters' 18-pitch walk keys White Sox's win vs. Guardians
noticias.texto: White Sox center fielder Tristan Peters' 18-pitch walk proved the turning point in a 7-3 win over the Guardians on Monday that put Chicago in the driver's seat for the AL Central title.

noticias.titular: Yankees clinch record 61st postseason berth, 9th in 10 years
noticias.texto: Aaron Judge hit his first home run since May 24 as the Yankees clinched their record 61st postseason berth and ninth in 10 years Monday night.

noticias.titular: Los Angeles Dodgers secure 14th consecutive playoff berth
noticias.texto: The Los Angeles Dodgers clinched their 14th consecutive playoff berth with a 4-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds at Great American Ball Park on Monday night behind Tarik Skubal's seven shutout innings and home runs by Kyle Tucker and Teoscar Hernandez.

noticias.titular: Dodgers manager Roberts doesn't expect IL stint for Freeman
noticias.texto: Even though Freddie Freeman hasn't been in the lineup for three of the past five games, manager Dave Roberts said putting him on the IL to get him ready for the postseason isn't an option at this point.

noticias.titular: Pete Alonso salutes thunderous ovations in Citi Field return
noticias.texto: Baltimore first baseman Pete Alonso made his first visit to Citi Field as an opposing player Monday in the Orioles' 2-1 win over the New York Mets, and he was greeted warmly by 35,800 fans who chanted the former Met's name during his plate appearances.
